title: Brake pads after overnight parking
summary: This topic mostly concerns brake pad and rotor behavior after the car sits overnight, with a few unrelated mentions of rear touch pads that make the cluster less coherent.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe overnight brake pad or rotor sticking noises as normal break-in behavior and mention guidance to warm or clean the brakes on the first drive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention rear touch pads and an incomplete overnight parking statement without enough detail to confirm a clear opinion about the brakes.

limitations: The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to fully characterize the topic.
